notes.title: Update 1.18 - Welcome to the dark side!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30649189/687205fea1e65392d15ea9a235e6cc95b92bf40f.gif

If you sometimes happen to find yourself scratching that puzzle-itch in the day's darker hours, then don't worry, we've got just the update for you! 
Twickles now features a dark color scheme, that's a bit easier on the eyes. 
Thanks to JimDeadlock for making the suggestion.

The complete list of changes:

 Added a dark color mode, accessible from the options menu.
 Fixed order of characters for Arabic language.
 Adjusted speed in scrollable lists.


Thank you for reading and happy puzzle solving!
Dennis

notes.title: Update 1.16 - Twickles' little helpers
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30649189/3c0edb63a84fa32e379f44722e1575d81427af7e.jpg

Oooopsy
Some of you might call the above a hidden feature. And you would be correct, of course!
It is totally not a developer-tool, never meant to be accessed by the users...

Sadly, I have the unfornuate job to tell you that we removed the hidden buttons. We also improved some other stuff, here's a complete list for all you Twicklinos™: [spoiler]It's a thing now, just roll with it![/spoiler]

     Accessing the hidden buttons in the options menu by clicking on them is no longer possible. Thanks to Avantyr for finding this issue.
     It is no longer possible to access locked parts and levels through keyboard or gamepad input. Shout-out to Enrique for discovering this glaring mistake.
     Scrolling of lists is smoother than ever.
     The language selection screen can now be exited using the keyboard, like all other menus.


A big thank you to the active people in the discussion boards.
By the way, we love to read your discussions and guides about optimal puzzle solutions.

Thank you for reading and happy puzzle solving!
Dennis

notes.title: Update 1.12 - Infinity and beyond!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30649189/fb69b6ea19cce1c985ecfddbe9f5ed040b6d8ab9.gif

Well, did you hear about that one secret achievement?
The one that had you meddling with black magic and sacrifing your newborn in order to get it?
Yeah okay, there was a bug. But we fixed it, all is well. (We can't refund your newborn though...)

Here's a complete list of changes for you motivated readers:

 Improved teleporter transportation.
 Trophy achievements will now unlock at the right time.
 Better gamepad support on Mac and Linux.
 More natural behaviour on scrollable lists when dragging.
 Lists will no longer scroll when selecting.
 Locked a tile in V-05 that allowed an unwanted perfect route.


Thank you for reading and happy puzzle solving!
Dennis
